name: Charlier
source:
A woman from a noble family in a certain country. She has a soft demeanor and is polite in her speech. She is proud of herself as a knight. She has a talent for handling the Philosopher's Stone, but she is even more skilled with a spear, which she has trained to the extent that she rivals Sofina in combat. She also has a meddlesome side and is trusted by her classmates.

[Translated from the [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/darklord/character.html#chr02]official website[/url]]
